bypass_actual_copper_leads.method: Constructed8-waygrid paths constrained to actual filled same-net copper union. Layer changes only at existing via/PTH centers, weighted by board thickness. Total lead length excludes capacitor/body internal span per ADM RevD p18. Distances are conservative grid route upper bounds, not full EM simulation.

budget.efficiency_scope: Illustrative full design-load estimate; not a guaranteed minimum efficiency. Do not apply at idle or add quiescent current a second time.
budget.hard_plug_input_requirement: Manufacturer calls for a 27 uF input electrolytic when hard plugging or exceeding input slew limit; especially important above 18 V. Remote Lower C8 is not proof of compliance at U12 pins.
budget.local_input_capacitor: C37 22 uF / 35 V X5R 20% 1206, TDK C3216X5R1V226M160AC; not a substitute for the manufacturer hard-plug electrolytic requirement
budget.full_current_temperature_scope: Manufacturer 3.3 V / 0.5 A derating curve allows full current to 90 C under its convection conditions; this is not the allowable temperature of the whole assembly.

local_regulator_power.scope: Illustrative switching-regulator power estimate, not guaranteed efficiency or enclosure thermal qualification. No SOT223 output-tab cooling assertion applies. C37/C38 are local decoupling; powered board mating is prohibited and input slew/hard-plug electrolytic requirements need independent verification.

prototype_required: Independent main/local rail on/off order and slow ramps
R78 U12 heat, VIN slew and main/local rail ripple/undershoot during relay switching
Actual total input current and fuse/inrush margin

limits: XML/PCB physical pin topology, part metadata, placement lower bounds, regulator pin map and filled copper inventory. Not EMC certification, high-voltage isolation qualification, full EM return-path extraction or physical prototype validation.

Lower_RC_filter.scope: Independent physical-pad topology check; native clearances and connectivity must separately prove that no copper bypass remains around R12.
